sources.title: UV Unwrapping Introduction - Blender 5.2 LTS Manual
sources.author: Blender Documentation Team
sources.observedEvidence: Full page. Unwrap when geometry is mostly stable; later faces need remapping. Faces can belong to multiple UV textures. Workflow: mark seams, select, unwrap method, test image for distortion, edit islands. New meshes have no UVs by default. Manual branded Blender 5.2 LTS.
sources.applicability: DCC UV gate. Portable: lock geo before hero unwrap; distortion test image is acceptance evidence.

sources.title: glTF 2.0 - Blender 5.2 LTS Manual
sources.author: Blender Documentation Team / glTF-Blender-IO
sources.observedEvidence: Full page. Add-on default-enabled. Quads triangulate; discontinuous UVs/hard edges split verts; curves must be meshed. Metal/rough PBR; metallic B, roughness G, occlusion R; tangent normals +Y up; PNG/JPEG required. UDIM split on export. Skin influences 4 or 8 for many viewers. Animations: object TRS, pose bones, shape keys only; game export via NLA-stashed actions. .glb vs separate vs embedded. Transmission extension support uneven in real-time engines. Developed at KhronosGroup/glTF-Blender-IO.
sources.applicability: Default interchange contract for Blender-sourced 3D. Lists exact data loss vs .blend.
sources.limitations: Not FBX. Engine importers may still drop extensions. Blender 5.2 LTS manual; older 4.x URL paths 404'd.

sources.title: Exporting projects — Godot 4.7 docs
sources.author: Godot Engine documentation
sources.observedEvidence: Full page. Presets in export_presets.cfg (committable); secrets in .godot/export_credentials.cfg (do not commit). Export templates required; ICU data for CJK/Thai/etc. Dedicated-server mode strips visuals. CLI godot --export-release; output path relative to project not CWD. PCK vs ZIP; ZIP needs launcher due to known bug. Platform texture compression differs (S3TC vs ETC). Dotfiles never packed.
sources.applicability: Godot packaging contract for Step 8/11.5. Credentials split is a portable ops idea.
sources.limitations: Godot-specific commands. Console/mobile still need platform SDKs.

sources.title: Saving games — Godot 4.7 docs
sources.author: Godot Engine documentation
sources.observedEvidence: Full page. Persist group; per-node save() dict; JSON lines in user://; load queue_frees then reinstantiates. JSON cannot store Vector2/Color/etc. Nested persist children break NodePaths. Binary FileAccess store_var alternative; only PROPERTY_USAGE_STORAGE. ConfigFile for settings. Points at official serialization demo.
sources.applicability: Teaching save pattern. Portable: identify persist set, versioned schema, parent-before-child load.
sources.limitations: Tutorial is not a production schema (no migrations, no checksum). JSON limitations are Godot-JSON specific.

sources.title: High-level multiplayer — Godot 4.7 docs
sources.author: Godot Engine documentation
sources.observedEvidence: Full page. MultiplayerAPI + ENet/WebRTC/WebSocket peers. High-level uses UDP; forward UDP. Server id 1. RPC NodePath + signature checksum of all @rpc in the script; argument lists not in checksum. Default authority/call_remote/reliable. Channels. HTML5 limited. Android INTERNET permission. Auth callbacks. Explicit: do not trust client positions/combat/inventory/outcomes. Cites Gaffer on Games. Dedicated-server export is separate; lobby sample is not dedicated-server ready.
sources.applicability: Conditional Godot net contract. Authority + RPC checksum are testable gates.
sources.limitations: Not a rollback netcode. Not Unreal/Unity. Security is design, not a built-in anti-cheat.

Indexes action anticipation, RPCs, NetworkAnimator, NetworkRigidbody, persistent player, connection approval, Relay vs IP, optional UGS Sessions/Auth. Git LFS required. sources.title: Topology - polycount wiki
sources.author: Polycount wiki contributors
sources.observedEvidence: Search extract. Topology = vertex/edge layout. Needed for realtime framerate and deformation. Sculpt bases want quads; game-ready lowpoly allows tris if every edge has a reason; subdivision needs loops. Deform hotspots: crotch/hips/butt, shoulders/armpits, mouth corners/cheeks, knees, elbows, hands/fingers. Density follows curvature then those joints. Page retrieve metadata 2017-03-07.
sources.applicability: Portable mesh-inspection checklist for any DCC.
sources.limitations: Community wiki, dated pages, not engine-official. LOD-specific page not separately opened.

sources.title: Character / Character Modeling - polycount wiki
sources.author: Polycount wiki contributors
sources.observedEvidence: Search extracts. Concept art first. High poly sculpt then retopo to in-game mesh; bake normals/AO. Typical process: blockout, rough sculpt, final sculpt, polypaint, retopo, unwrap, then rig/animate. Character Modeling page distinguishes box-model vs retopo from high. Retrieved 2018-09-09 / 2017-05-18.
sources.applicability: Same granularity as Blender Studio: identity → block → high → low → UV → shade → rig.
sources.limitations: Wiki, not a studio bible. Tool names (ZBrush, etc.) are examples.

sources.title: BodyTopology - polycount wiki
sources.author: Polycount wiki; image credit Brian Tindall (Pixar)
sources.observedEvidence: Search extract. Gallery of body topology. 'Articulation - Modeling and Theory topology examples. Image by Brian Tindall, Character Technical Director at Pixar.' Also Jonathan Williamson, game-character examples (BloodRayne 2, Bayonetta). Retrieved 2015-12-12.

sources.limitations: Images not independently viewed this session. Old page. Not a written Tindall tutorial.

sources.title: Texel / Texturing / Edge padding - polycount wiki
sources.author: Polycount wiki contributors (edge padding examples on wiki.polycount.com/wiki/Edge_padding)
sources.observedEvidence: Search extracts. Texel = texture sample in-engine, distinct from texture pixels and screen pixels. Texturing page: powers-of-two sizes; consistent scaling across a scene. Edge padding examples: 256→2px, 512→4px, 1024→8px, 2048→16px; gutter ~2× pad; fill empty areas. Normal-map page: tangent space for deforming meshes; UV seams cause shading seams; mirrored UVs need padding.
sources.applicability: Numeric starting points for UV/padding gates. Confirm on target engine mips.
sources.limitations: Heuristic, not a measured budget. Pages dated 2016–2021.
